items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: And the director of the band was Rory Carter. And I was in this great band.

ctx.x: Eastman, Eastman, yeah. All of these, across the country. And the director of the band was Rory Carter. And I was in this great band. We had a great band. Because we had some of the professional musicians who were working in Chicago in this band. The band was tough. And we won the award for best band. I won two awards for best saxophonist and best soloist. We won — another guy won best composer, and best vocalist I think. So we won five awards. We took nearly all of it. And it was great. And because of that there…
